cues: Some can wait. Some need an answer now.
In AIRFLOW’s Attention icon, turquoise currents represent competing demands.
The gold point marks what needs your focus right now.
Four patterns help you design for attention.
Protect focus, fit the challenge, bring feedback closer, and keep useful friction.
Imagine writing a report while urgent requests keep arriving.
Before you start, agree on a focus window with your team.
Let routine requests wait. Route urgent ones to a named backup.
Agree what qualifies as urgent and when the backup should interrupt you.
Afterwards, check the report, the urgent responses, and the backup’s workload.
Try it once. What needs to change before you repeat it?
